upstream.vendored_files: Only portable validators and bundle helpers under vendor/gods-eye-view are reproduced. See their retained LICENSE.
upstream.validation_scope: Document, geometry, action references, bundle integrity and export/import round-trip. Full application UI and live feeds have not been run.

retrieval_method: Direct HTTPS API retrieval; response JSON parsed and canonicalised. Capture time is recorded after both requests complete.
note: Hashes identify canonicalised response JSON in data/nea-snapshot.json, not original HTTP response bytes.
